title: Decision: wire.h static_assert size guards catch ABI drift before it becomes ENOTTY at runtime
description: crypto2dev_wire.h:L235-254. The _IOW/_IOR macros encode sizeof(struct) into the ioctl request code. If any struct field changes size without updating the kernel driver, the request code silently mismatches and every ioctl returns ENOTTY with no diagnostic about which struct changed. The compile-time wc_static_assert2 checks catch this immediately. A contributor who adds a field must update both the struct AND the expected size constant. Do not remove or weaken these guards — they are the only protection against a silent ABI break.
